description: Place a LIVE manual order exactly like the app's ticket: market or limit, post-only, resting (Polymarket time_in_force GTC), reduce-only, leverage up to the venue maximum. This moves real money. Opening orders stay within this key's max_order_usd and max_daily_usd and the account's portfolio mandate. An account's own key does not fund from Home: fund the venue first with fund_hypercore_from_arc or fund_polymarket_from_arc. If the account owner's trading policy (the app's device trading policy) is missing or within 3 days of expiry, it is signed locally first and returned in trading_policy (it includes Lighter Premium and Felix partner-fee consent). Reuse the same idempotency_key to retry safely; read the outcome with get_manual_order_receipt.

accept_trading_policy.description: Only after the owner answered yes to the trading_policy question this tool returned.

expected_position_id.description: With reduce_only, the position this order reduces.

funding.description: Fund this order's venue from the account's Home: {max_source_units, max_fee_units, expires_at}, integers (USDC 6-decimal units; expires_at in Unix seconds). Needs a key with the 'transfer' scope (the launcher's own account). A child account's trading key cannot: fund the venue first (fund_hypercore_from_arc for Hyperliquid), then order without funding.

idempotency_key.description: Retry-safety key; reuse it for retries of the same order. Auto-generated when omitted.

leverage.description: Leverage for perps, 1 up to the venue maximum for the market.

outcome.description: Polymarket outcome name (e.g. Yes, No, a team, Draw).

post_only.description: Limit orders only: rest on the book, never take (Hyperliquid, Lighter; Polymarket with time_in_force GTC).

side.description: buy or sell (perps: buy = long, sell = short).

time_in_force.description: Polymarket only: FAK (default, fill what is there now) or GTC (rest on the book; limit only).

name: place_manual_order
